source_caption:
One of the most original love stories ever told. 🎞️

Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind doesn't give you a fairytale; it gives you the truth. It’s a breathtaking study of the human heart that proves even if you could wipe every memory of a person from your head, you’d still find yourself on that same train to Montauk, meeting them for the first time, all over again. It’s about accepting the mess, the flaws, and the inevitable "Okay" because the connection is simply hard-coded into your DNA. Whether you’re meeting for the first time or the fifty-first, this is the reality of love: it’s a beautiful, infinite loop. 
.
.
